title: cost-optimization: autotune defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: reduce per-token cost and operational overhead by providing safe defaults and automated tuning for batching, KV prefix caching, and quantization profiles; expose unit-economics tooling to help teams pick tradeoffs. Scope: introduce an autotune controller that suggests/sets batching and cache defaults per-model and per-deployment, add a quantization profile registry + safe fallbacks, and add a unit-econ CLI endpoint and small console view. Changes include runtime heuristics, config schema updates, a lightweight telemetry ping for suggested settings, and UX in the console. Checklist: - [x] design doc (ENG-1452) linked; - [x] unit tests for controller heuristics; - [x] integration tests with runtime; - [x] console endpoint + basic UI; - [x] migration for existing quant profiles. Notes: This is backward compatible: defaults are recommendations unless customer opts in. Includes an emergency opt-out flag. See design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/board/ENG-1452; related incident/SUP-4421 for cost spike context. Testing: locally validated against perf-canary with 3 model families (redwood-1-small, redwood-1-medium, open-llama-7b) and synthetic workloads. Rollout: staged canary to 10% Dedicated, then 50%, then GA controlled via feature flag. Risk: quant profiles may change latency characteristics; rollback plan provided. Release notes: Adds autotune defaults for batching & caching, quantization profile registry, and unit-economics tooling (console + CLI).
